commentTemplates.reReviewCommandTemplate: Reviewer notes updated for {findingTitles} in run `{runId}`. {reReviewCommand}

norms: Keep the patch minimal and self-contained; refactor only what the issue explicitly requires.
Follow the existing module layout and naming; a meridian change never introduces a new top-level package on its own.
Do not widen public exports or configuration surface without an accepted upstream issue saying so.
Prefer reusing the helpers in scripts/lib over writing parallel logic; cite the reused helper in the summary.
Declare anything the run could not verify in the validation-gap section instead of silently dropping it.
